{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float after removing commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and exclude QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']
print(f'Number of completed orders: {len(completed_orders)}')

# Now filter out QA orders from completed orders
valid_completed = completed_orders[~completed_orders.index.isin(qa_orders.index)]
print(f'Number of valid completed orders (after removing QA): {len(valid_completed)}')

# Group by channel and sum revenue
channel_revenue = valid_completed.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()
print('\nRevenue by channel (after cleaning):')
print(channel_revenue)

# Find the channel with the highest total revenue
max_channel = channel_revenue.loc[channel_revenue['revenue'].idxmax()]
print(f'\nChannel with highest revenue: {max_channel['channel']} with ${max_channel['revenue']:,.2f}')"}
